class.name: rviz_camera_control/CameraControlPanel
class.description: Bridges ROS 2 topics to the RViz render camera. Publishes CameraState telemetry for whatever view controller is active, and forwards CameraCommand messages to the camera whenever the "rviz_camera_control/External" view controller is active.

class.name: rviz_camera_control/External
class.description: Camera view controller whose position, orientation, field of view and clip planes are set entirely by an external caller (normally CameraControlPanel, in response to ROS 2 CameraCommand messages) instead of by mouse interaction.
